nameOrigin: fictional island inhabited by small people

pokedexEntries.bk: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

pokedexEntries.wh: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.

pokedexEntries.x: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.or: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.y: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.

pokedexEntries.as: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it’s also smart enough to check its foe’s strength and avoid battle.

pokedexEntries.su: Because it doesn’t yelp, it’s extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

pokedexEntries.mo: The long fur surrounding its face functions as radar, enabling it to probe the condition of its battle opponents.

pokedexEntries.us: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can’t defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

pokedexEntries.um: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it’s intelligent, obedient to its Trainer’s commands, and easy to raise.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon is far brighter than the average child, and Lillipup won’t forget the love it receives or any abuse it suffers.
